sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件心爱的宝贝去工作，并将DJ台

sentences.en: into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一座充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: We begin in Russia, where police have launched a murder investigation after the daughter of a pro-Kremlin commentator was killed in a car bomb explosion near Moscow.
sentences.zh: 我们从俄罗斯开始报道，在莫斯科附近发生一起汽车炸弹爆炸事件，导致一位亲克里姆林宫评论员的女儿身亡后，警方已展开谋杀调查。

sentences.en: Dead at the scene, Daria Dugina, daughter of influential ultranationalist Alexander Duggan.
sentences.zh: 死者是达莉娅·杜金娜，她是极具影响力的极端民族主义者亚历山大·杜金的女儿。

sentences.en: A few days ago, when a prominent supporter of Russia's invasion of Ukraine was killed in a car bomb outside of Moscow,
sentences.zh: 几天前，当一位俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的坚定支持者在莫斯科郊外死于汽车炸弹袭击时，

sentences.en: speculation immediately turned to who had carried out the attack.
sentences.zh: 舆论立即转向了谁是幕后黑手这一问题。

sentences.en: Now, as the war crosses the six-month mark, the other question is how this attack could fundamentally change the course of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着战争进入第六个月，另一个问题是，这次袭击将如何从根本上改变冲突的进程。

sentences.en: President Zelensky has warned that Russia might be planning something particularly nasty in revenge.
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基总统警告称，俄罗斯可能正在策划某种极其恶毒的报复行动。

sentences.en: My colleague, Moscow Bureau Chief Anton Treyanovsky, has been covering the aftermath.
sentences.zh: 我的同事，莫斯科分社社长安东·特罗亚诺夫斯基一直在跟进报道后续情况。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月25日，星期四。

sentences.en: Anton, tell me about Alexander Dugan and his daughter Daria.
sentences.zh: 安东，跟我聊聊亚历山大·杜金和他的女儿达莉娅吧。

sentences.en: Let's start with the father.
sentences.zh: 我们先从父亲说起。

sentences.en: So Alexander Dugan is 60 years old.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·杜金今年60岁。

sentences.en: He started out as an anti-communist dissident back in the last years of the Soviet Union and has morphed into this self-styled, self-educated, long-haired philosopher
sentences.zh: 他最初是苏联末期的反共异见人士，后来演变成了一位自封的、自学的、留着长发的哲学家

sentences.en: slash political theoriSt.
sentences.zh: 兼政治理论家。

sentences.en: And he's important because he's really one of the leading exponents of this idea of Russian imperialism, of Russia deserving and needing to be an empire
sentences.zh: 他之所以重要，是因为他是俄罗斯帝国主义思想的主要倡导者之一，他认为俄罗斯理应成为、也必须成为一个帝国，

sentences.en: that dominates this whole swath of Eurasian territory from Central Europe all the way to the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 统治从东欧一直延伸到太平洋的整个欧亚大陆领土。

sentences.en: What's behind that idea?
sentences.zh: 这种思想背后的逻辑是什么？

sentences.en: What's the philosophy that actually drives it?
sentences.zh: 驱动它的哲学基础是什么？

sentences.en: So the key term behind it is this concept of Eurasianism.
sentences.zh: 其核心术语是“欧亚主义”这一概念。

sentences.en: I always believed and I believe in the future greatness of Russia because Russia was always and tried to be a superpower.
sentences.zh: 我一直相信，并且坚信俄罗斯未来的伟大，因为俄罗斯一直以来都在努力成为一个超级大国。

sentences.en: It's our dream.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的梦想。

sentences.en: This idea that Russia is rightfully at the center of a Eurasian empire, that Russia has its own culture and values that it should kind of impose upon that empire.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为，俄罗斯理应处于欧亚帝国的中心，俄罗斯拥有自己的文化和价值观，并应将其强加于该帝国之上。

sentences.en: Well, it is idea that the West should not have hegemony in defining the universal standards.
sentences.zh: 没错，这种观点认为西方不应在定义普世标准方面拥有霸权。

sentences.en: And that it's also locked in this inevitable existential conflict with what Dugan refers to as the Atlantic empire, which, as you might imagine, is dominated by the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且俄罗斯与杜金所称的“大西洋帝国”（你可以想象，那是以美国为主导的）之间，正陷入一场不可避免的生存冲突。

sentences.en: Our position is that we are going to fight up to the end in order to show to everybody that the United States is not any more unique master.
sentences.zh: 我们的立场是，我们将战斗到底，向所有人证明美国不再是唯一的霸主。

sentences.en: It's very serious, very serious.
sentences.zh: 这非常严肃，非常严肃。

sentences.en: I think he would say that Russia is destined to be in conflict with the United States and that Ukraine is essentially one of those battlefields
sentences.zh: 我想他会说，俄罗斯注定要与美国发生冲突，而乌克兰本质上就是这场冲突将要上演的战场之一。

sentences.en: where that conflict is going to play out.
sentences.zh: （战场之一）

sentences.en: He sees Ukraine as rightfully belonging to Russia's empire, Russia's sphere of influence, and Russia needs to control Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他认为乌克兰理应属于俄罗斯的帝国，属于俄罗斯的势力范围，俄罗斯必须控制乌克兰。

sentences.en: That does sound similar to a lot of what Putin has said about this war.
sentences.zh: 这听起来和普京关于这场战争的许多言论很相似。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, does Dugan represent Putin's views on this?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，杜金是否代表了普京在这方面的观点？

sentences.en: So, yes, it does sound similar, but you also have to realize that even though we think of Putin as this super nationalist strongman,
sentences.zh: 是的，听起来确实相似，但你必须意识到，尽管我们认为普京是一位超级民族主义强人，

sentences.en: Dugan and people like him are actually in Russia's domestic political system a lot more hawkish than Putin.
sentences.zh: 但在俄罗斯国内政治体系中，杜金及其同类实际上比普京更加鹰派。

sentences.en: That is not Putin who imposes on us monarchism or authoritarian rule.
sentences.zh: 并不是普京强加给我们君主制或威权统治。

sentences.en: We demand from him to be much more authoritarian than he is.
sentences.zh: 是我们要求他比现在更加独裁。

sentences.en: So, he a little bit disappoints us because it takes too long.
sentences.zh: 所以，他让我们有点失望，因为他动作太慢了。

sentences.en: Dugan has been calling for this kind of invasion of Ukraine for years.
sentences.zh: 杜金多年来一直呼吁这种对乌克兰的入侵。

sentences.en: He listened to you, but he's going too slow.
sentences.zh: 他听了你们的话，但他行动太慢了。

sentences.en: Too slow, yes.
sentences.zh: 太慢了，是的。

sentences.en: He has long said that Putin isn't being aggressive enough in terms of trying to rebuild a Russian empire.
sentences.zh: 他长期以来一直说，普京在重建俄罗斯帝国方面不够激进。

sentences.en: So, when the invasion of Ukraine happened on February 24th,
sentences.zh: 所以，当2月24日入侵乌克兰发生时，

sentences.en: Dugan suddenly looked like a genius because it was that empire mindset that he had long advocated that Putin was suddenly bringing to life in such a violent way.
sentences.zh: 杜金突然看起来像个天才，因为正是他长期倡导的那种帝国心态，被普京以如此暴力的方式付诸实践。

sentences.en: So, the moment met Dugan in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上，那个时刻成就了杜金。

sentences.en: What about his daughter?
sentences.zh: 那他的女儿呢？

sentences.en: What can you tell us about her?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们关于她的什么信息？

sentences.en: So, her name is Daria Dugana.
sentences.zh: 她叫达莉娅·杜金娜。

sentences.en: She was 29.
sentences.zh: 她今年29岁。

sentences.en: And she was less well-known than her father, but really became quite an important figure in the Russian media and propaganda landscape in her own right.
sentences.zh: 她不如她父亲出名，但她本身确实已成为俄罗斯媒体和宣传领域中相当重要的人物。

sentences.en: She became very skilled in using the internet, social media, and television to kind of promote those ideas of Russian imperialism and anti-Americanism that her father laid out
sentences.zh: 她非常擅长利用互联网、社交媒体和电视，来推广她父亲以那种高度知识化方式所阐述的俄罗斯帝国主义和反美主义思想。

sentences.en: in this very intellectual way.
sentences.zh: （知识化方式）

sentences.en: And so, when the invasion of Ukraine happened, this was her moment as well, in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以，当入侵乌克兰发生时，在某种程度上，这也是属于她的时刻。

sentences.en: We can see that it is not only the conflict between Ukraine and Russia.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到，这不仅仅是乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的冲突。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: This is the conflict between two civilizations.
sentences.zh: 这是两种文明之间的冲突。

sentences.en: The Ukrainian part, which has chosen the globalization, the Anglo-Saxon hegemony, the imperialism of America, of United States, and we see the alternative.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰方面选择了全球化、盎格鲁-撒克逊霸权、美国的帝国主义，而我们看到了另一种选择。

sentences.en: She was a young, fresh face in the Russian ultra-nationalist milieu and really became a disinformation warrior in her own right.
sentences.zh: 她是俄罗斯极端民族主义圈子里年轻、新鲜的面孔，确实成为了名副其实的虚假信息战士。

sentences.en: The special military operations showed that the globalist era is over and this is the beginning of the multipolarity.
sentences.zh: 特别军事行动表明，全球化时代已经结束，这是多极化的开始。

sentences.en: And she actually became so prominent that earlier this year, back in March, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她实际上变得非常突出，以至于今年早些时候，也就是3月，美国

sentences.en: actually sanctioned her for being a influence actor promoting the invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因为她是推动入侵乌克兰的影响力人物，而对她实施了制裁。

sentences.en: So Daria Dugana is important and influential enough for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以达莉娅·杜金娜的重要性和影响力足以让美国

sentences.en: to punish her as part of its broader effort to punish Russia for invading Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 将她作为惩罚俄罗斯入侵乌克兰这一更广泛行动的一部分进行制裁。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, she, in this world of Russian ultra-nationalists had a lot of potential to reach different generations with this message until her death last Saturday night.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在俄罗斯极端民族主义者的世界里，她有很大的潜力向不同世代传递这一信息，直到她上周六晚去世。

sentences.en: So, Anton, tell me about that attack on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 那么，安东，跟我说说周六那次袭击吧。

sentences.en: So, on Saturday,
sentences.zh: 周六，

sentences.en: Alexander Dugan and Daria Dugana went to this patriotic nationalist festival outside of Moscow.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·杜金和达莉娅·杜金娜去参加了莫斯科郊外的一个爱国民族主义节日。

sentences.en: Dugan read a lecture sitting in a tent in the woods about the metaphysical dualism of historical thinking.
sentences.zh: 杜金坐在树林里的帐篷里，做了一场关于历史思维形而上二元论的讲座。

sentences.en: You had musicians, including a group of singing priests.
sentences.zh: 现场还有音乐家，包括一个唱歌的牧师团体。

sentences.en: And around 9 p.m., from what we understand,
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，大约在晚上9点，

sentences.en: both Daria and her father left the festival.
sentences.zh: 达莉娅和她父亲离开了节日现场。

sentences.en: Daria got into a Toyotaland cruiser, either hers or her dad's, we don't know for sure.
sentences.zh: 达莉娅坐进了一辆丰田陆地巡洋舰，我们不确定那是她的还是她父亲的车。

sentences.en: And Alexander Dugan apparently was about to get into the same car with her before changing his mind and getting into a different car and basically following her
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·杜金显然正要和她坐同一辆车，但后来改变了主意，坐进了另一辆车，基本上是跟在她的车后

sentences.en: out of the festival, headed back toward Moscow.
sentences.zh: 离开了节日现场，准备返回莫斯科。

sentences.en: They drove for a couple miles, a few minutes, until a bomb went off under that Toyotaland cruiser that Daria was driving.
sentences.zh: 他们开了几英里，几分钟后，达莉娅驾驶的那辆丰田陆地巡洋舰下方的炸弹爆炸了。

sentences.en: According to Russian news reports, the bomb carried something like the force of a pound of TNT.
sentences.zh: 据俄罗斯新闻报道，炸弹的威力相当于一磅TNT炸药。

sentences.en: It was such a strong blast that it set the car on fire and even knocked the windows out of the houses in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 爆炸威力巨大，不仅导致汽车起火，甚至震碎了附近房屋的窗户。

sentences.en: Dugan, like I said, was traveling behind her.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，杜金当时正开车跟在她后面。

sentences.en: So there's video of him getting out of his car and pacing back and forth at the scene of the blast, his hands on his head.
sentences.zh: 所以有视频显示他从车里出来，在爆炸现场来回踱步，双手抱头。

sentences.en: He had clearly just witnessed his daughter die.
sentences.zh: 他显然刚刚目睹了女儿的死亡。

sentences.en: And within minutes of this, there was talk on social media of some car bomb attack in Moscow, potentially taking out Daria Dugana.
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生几分钟内，社交媒体上就出现了关于莫斯科发生汽车炸弹袭击、可能导致达莉娅·杜金娜身亡的讨论。

sentences.en: And you have to remember that modern-day Moscow, you don't see car bombs.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，在现代莫斯科，你根本看不到汽车炸弹。

sentences.en: It's actually a very peaceful city with relatively little crime.
sentences.zh: 那实际上是一个非常和平的城市，犯罪率相对较低。

sentences.en: So this was a very dramatic and startling scene.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常戏剧性且令人震惊的场景。

sentences.en: And how does official Russian media react?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体有何反应？

sentences.en: How does the Kremlin respond?
sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫是如何回应的？

sentences.en: Well, in the immediate aftermath of the bombing, so on Sunday, official media is quiet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在爆炸发生后的第一时间，也就是周日，官方媒体保持沉默。

sentences.en: But on social media, which obviously is very influential in Russia, that void is filled by Daria Dugana's friends and associates and really that whole ultra-nationalist milieu
sentences.zh: 但在俄罗斯显然非常有影响力的社交媒体上，这一空白被达莉娅·杜金娜的朋友、同事以及我们之前谈到的整个极端民族主义圈子所填补，

sentences.en: that we talked about before,
sentences.zh: （我们谈到的）

sentences.en: where they are immediately blaming it on Ukraine, blaming it on President Zelensky, and calling for revenge.
sentences.zh: 他们立即将其归咎于乌克兰，归咎于泽连斯基总统，并呼吁复仇。

sentences.en: And by Monday,
sentences.zh: 到了周一，

sentences.en: 36 hours after the attack,
sentences.zh: 袭击发生36小时后，

sentences.en: Russian state media picks up that message too and runs with it.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯国家媒体也采纳了这一说法并大肆报道。

sentences.en: Because Monday morning, the FSB,
sentences.zh: 因为周一早上，俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB），

sentences.en: Russia's domestic intelligence agency, put out a statement saying they had solved the crime and said that Ukrainian intelligence was behind the attack.
sentences.zh: 也就是俄罗斯的国内情报机构，发表声明称他们已经破案，并表示乌克兰情报部门是此次袭击的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: And who do they say actually perpetrated the attack?
sentences.zh: 他们说到底是谁实施了袭击？

sentences.en: I mean, who did it, according to the FSB?
sentences.zh: 我是说，根据FSB的说法，是谁干的？

sentences.en: Well, on Monday morning, the FSB came out with a statement claiming to have solved the case and telling this story that I'll say right up front, a lot of people did not believe.
sentences.zh: 嗯，周一早上，FSB发表声明称已破案，并讲述了一个我必须提前说明——很多人并不相信的故事。

sentences.en: But what the FSB said was a Ukrainian woman drove across the border into Russia, driving a gray Mini Cooper in July with her young daughter in tow.
sentences.zh: 但FSB称，一名乌克兰女子于7月带着年幼的女儿，驾驶一辆灰色Mini Cooper越过边境进入俄罗斯。

sentences.en: The FSB said she rented an apartment in the same building as where Daria Dugana was staying in Moscow.
sentences.zh: FSB称，她在达莉娅·杜金娜在莫斯科居住的同一栋楼里租了一间公寓。

sentences.en: They say she carried out the attack, then fled Russia successfully into Estonia, driving that same Mini Cooper, but now using a different license plate.
sentences.zh: 他们说她实施了袭击，然后驾驶同一辆Mini Cooper成功逃离俄罗斯进入爱沙尼亚，但当时已经换了车牌。

sentences.en: And they described this as an assassination directed
sentences.zh: 他们将其描述为一场由乌克兰情报部门

sentences.en: by Ukrainian intelligence.
sentences.zh: 指挥的暗杀行动。

sentences.en: And Ukraine has denied this.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰否认了这一点。

sentences.en: They came out and said right on Sunday that they are not in the business of killing civilians in Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们周日就出来声明，他们不干在俄罗斯杀害平民这种事。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So then on Tuesday, you have this really remarkable memorial service for Daria Dugana.
sentences.zh: 周二，为达莉娅·杜金娜举行了一场非常引人注目的追悼会。

sentences.en: It takes place at this big TV studio complex in Moscow where a lot of state TV programs are produced.
sentences.zh: 地点在莫斯科的一个大型电视演播室综合体，许多国家电视台的节目都在那里制作。

sentences.en: A lot of leading figures in the Russian nationalist movement are there as are various politicians and TV hosts.
sentences.zh: 许多俄罗斯民族主义运动的领军人物都在场，还有各种政客和电视主持人。

sentences.en: And so Russian propaganda, after initially not knowing what to do, has decided to essentially turn her into a martyr.
sentences.zh: 所以俄罗斯宣传机构在最初不知所措后，决定基本上把她塑造成一名烈士。

sentences.en: You know, one really incredible moment was when Alexander Dugan, her father, spoke.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一个非常令人难以置信的时刻是亚历山大·杜金，也就是她的父亲，发表讲话时。

sentences.en: He had just lost his daughter three days ago for his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他三天前才刚刚亲眼目睹女儿离世。

sentences.en: And he said she had died for victory and basically said she wouldn't want us to glorify her in death.
sentences.zh: 他说她为胜利而死，并表示她不会希望我们在她死后美化她。

sentences.en: The one thing she would want is us to win this war.
sentences.zh: 她唯一希望的是我们赢得这场战争。

sentences.en: So Anton,
sentences.zh: 所以安东，
